title: KK Cibona have won U17 National Championship
description: KK Cibona U17 - KK Zadar U17 74-66 KK Cibona have won U17 National Championship. In the Final game they edged KK Zadar U17 74-66. Both teams nailed 18 points each at the start and only due to a 12-11 run, Cibiona had a 1-point halftime advantage. KK Cibona managed to push the tempo for good in the second half and secured 26-22 and 18-15 rallies. Zvonimir Dujakovic (203-F-2008) stepped up with 20 points and Ante Garac (183-G-2009) netted 16. Sime Grbin (C-2008) replied with 19 points in a loss and Jakov Toncinic (2008) poured in 15.
